list.arch:
<tree>
                    <field name="name" on_change="1" modifiers="{"required": true}"/>
                    <field name="code" modifiers="{"required": true}"/>
                    <field name="type" modifiers="{"required": true}"/>
                    <field name="cont_type"/>
                    <field name="active"/>
                    <field name="note"/>
                </tree>

form.arch:
<form>
                    <sheet>
                        <group>
                            <field name="name" on_change="1" modifiers="{"required": true}"/>
                            <field name="code" modifiers="{"required": true}"/>
                            <field name="type" modifiers="{"required": true}"/>
                            <field name="cont_type" widget="radio" options="{'horizontal': True}"/>
                            <field name="active"/>
                            <field name="note"/>
                        </group>
                    </sheet>
                </form>

search.arch:
<search>
                    <field name="name"/>
                    <field name="code"/>
                    <field name="note"/>
                    <filter string="Archived" name="archived" domain="[('active', '=', False)]"/>
                </search>
